comments.quote: 距離下面吃喝地方有點遠，距離遊客集散中心更遠，走路將近半個小時，肯定不止一公里，開車可能比較方便。地段較為安靜，但房間不太隔音。房間既然有浴缸，結果浴缸水龍頭放的水不熱，水特別小，根本泡不了。房間比較乾淨，不過浴室窗户那邊不是全封閉的，早上有光線。景色還可以。老闆比較熱情，價格不算低，整體感覺還湊合吧。
comments.author: Guest User
comments.quoteEn: A fair way from the food and drink below and further still from the visitor centre, close to half an hour on foot and certainly more than a kilometre, so driving is easier. The area is quiet but the rooms are not well soundproofed. There is a bath in the room, but the tap ran barely warm and at a trickle, so a soak was out of the question. The room was fairly clean, though the bathroom window is not fully enclosed and light comes in early. The views are decent. The owner is warm, the price is not low, and overall it was passable.

comments.quote: 房間很乾凈 壞境也很好 服務很好 去參加比賽住在那 老闆還開車送我們到比賽現場 人很熱情 早餐吃的蒸板栗 板栗是她媽媽自己種的 很好吃😋
comments.author: Guest User
